name: My agents: owner, filter and duplicate-name warning
summary: Each My agents row shows its owner account plus the agent id from the agent_view payload (owner, owner_display_name, id; line 'name (owner-id) · agent-id'); a Mine/All filter (default Mine, caller-level and stable across pages, audit view for superuser+inferred-scopes shows all loaded rows) renders only for a superuser or when the caller may see more than one owner (whole-list probe when the total exceeds the page); creating an agent whose name matches any name the NEW agent's account (chosen owner for a superuser, caller otherwise) already uses warns with the existing name, owner and id plus a confirm saying which pool was checked (cross-owner reuse stays allowed; the server 409 on secret-file clash stays the backstop); an agent that has acted (last_seen_at set) carries a disable-not-delete hint naming attribution. No visibility change: the server scopes the list as before.
